high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the user "itskaywithme," who is located in New York, New York. The post features a black-and-white illustration of two skulls. One skull is smoking a cigarette, exhaling smoke, while the other skull is holding its hand to its mouth as if it's about to take a drag on the cigarette. The background is entirely black, which makes the white outlines of the skulls stand out prominently. Below the illustration, there is a caption that reads: "I am a nightmare; You're no different." This text adds a dark and somewhat ominous tone to the image
